50 | Serpent Gate | 1 being | varies | 10' | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster’s eyes appear as those of a snake. Those who view the caster see his
eyes as slits. This has no value other than as an illusion and can be detected
as such.
@@ 2
Caster charms one snake. That snake will not attack him, and will follow his
non-violent suggestions.
@@ 3
Caster magically summons a viper that will arrive in two rounds. It will act
as the caster directs it.
@@ 4
Caster’s mouth fills with razor-like teeth that can be used to make Small Bite
attacks.
@@ 5
Caster’s eyes become hypnotic to one target. Target must make a RR or be
stunned for the duration.
@@ 6
As Summon Viper, except it summons a cobra.
@@ 7
As Charm Snake I, except it can effect up to two snakes.
@@ 8
As Snake Bite I, except caster can make Medium Bite attacks.
@@ 9
As Summon Viper, except it summons a python.
@@ 10
Caster’s next summoning spell from this list (cast within the duration) will
summon two snakes.
@@ 11
Caster gains total control over the actions of one snake.
@@ 12
The caster’s bite this round will inject a mild poison into the target with
any critical that is delivered. Type of poison should be determined by the
Gamemaster.
@@ 13
Caster summons a special type of snake that is common to the terrain he is in.
In the forest, this could be a Horned Snake; in the snow, a Giant Furred
Snake; etc.
@@ 14
As Snake Bite I, except caster can make Large Bite attacks.
@@ 15
As Master Snake I, except it can affect up to two snakes.
@@ 16
As Poison Bite I, except it injects a moderate poison.
@@ 17
Caster summons a giant snake. The details are left to the GM.
@@ 18
As Multi-Summoning II, except three snakes will be summoned.
@@ 19
As Master Snake I, except it can affect up to three snakes.
@@ 20
As Poison Bite I, except it injects a severe poison.
@@ 25
As Multi-Summoning II, except five snakes will be summoned.
@@ 30
As Poison Bite I, except it injects an extreme poison.
@@ 50
Caster opens up a magical gate to a mythical or legendary snake creature or
perhaps a powerful snake lord. Details are left up to the GM.
